summary: Bain Capital Private Credit filed an 8-K reporting a regular monthly distribution of $0.1875 per Class I share, payable August 31, 2026, to holders of record July 31, 2026. The filing also discloses NAV per share of $25.89 as of June 30, 2026, aggregate NAV of $1,136.9 million, and a debt-to-equity ratio of 1.09x. Additionally, it notes that a previously announced tender offer to repurchase up to 5% of Class I shares expired on June 1, 2026, with only 1.27% of shares tendered, and that the fund received $139.6 million in new subscriptions. The filing is a routine current report providing periodic disclosures; none of the disclosed items constitutes a special situation.
